title: Shanghai AI Lab open-sources Sage-Interaction, reshaping a new paradigm for full-duplex interaction with an extreme latency of 1.29 seconds
excerpt: In our daily interactions with AI, we often fall into a subtle sense of frustration: we have to stiffly wait for the model to finish delivering a long monologue
content_html:
In our daily interactions with AI, we often fall into a subtle sense of frustration: we have to stiffly wait for the model to finish delivering a long monologue before we can interject; once we interrupt, the conversational context instantly collapses. This "one question, one answer" half-duplex mode keeps AI carrying a strong "customer service bot" flavor, making it hard for it to truly blend into natural, high-frequency human collaboration scenarios full of interruptions and overlap.

The key moment to break through this interaction barrier has arrived. Recently, Shanghai AI Laboratory officially open-sourced the full-duplex multimodal model Sage-Interaction, aiming to drive large models from one-way "command-response" machines toward a completely new interaction paradigm of "communicate while collaborating while getting things done."

 Core breakthrough: true "interrupt anytime," reshaping conversational rhythm

The greatest value of Sage-Interaction lies in its deep refinement of "full-duplex" capabilities. It no longer requires users to follow rigid turn-taking rules, but supports interrupting and interjecting at any time during voice interaction. The model can keenly capture shifts in user intent and smoothly transition to new topics, perfectly replicating the dynamic rhythm of face-to-face human communication. This ability to "listen and keep up" is a core sign of AI moving from a "tool" to a "digital partner."

 Extreme performance: 1.29-second response, topping both open- and closed-source models

The difficulty of full-duplex interaction lies not only in "being able to interrupt," but also in "responding quickly." Any delay beyond the threshold of human patience instantly shatters immersion.

Sage-Interaction has delivered a highly dominant answer here:

- Response latency as low as 1.29 seconds: This figure is not only far better than comparable open-source models, but also ranks first among all current open- and closed-source duplex models, completely eliminating the "lag" in interaction.

- Interaction quality score of 80.73: In rigorous duplex voice interaction quality evaluations, the model demonstrates extremely high naturalness and coherence, effectively avoiding the logical breaks or voice stutters that traditional models exhibit after interruptions.

- Cutting-edge streaming video understanding: In addition to voice, the model also reaches the open-source frontier in processing streaming video input, laying a solid foundation for multimodal real-time collaboration (such as remote guidance and real-time visual analysis).

 Industry insight: low latency and full duplex are the "infrastructure" of human-AI trust

In the past, competition among large models often focused on parameter counts or leaderboard scores, while overlooking interaction experience—the front-end touchpoint that determines user retention. The open-sourcing of Sage-Interaction sends a clear signal: AI's next battle is a dimensionality-reducing strike in interaction paradigms.

When response latency is compressed to 1.29 seconds, and when "interjecting anytime" becomes the norm, the psychological barrier between users and AI will truly be broken. This seamlessly connected collaborative experience will greatly accelerate AI's deployment in high-value scenarios such as smart cockpits, real-time translation, virtual companionship, and complex task collaboration.

Shanghai AI Lab's open-sourcing this time not only delivers a high-performance technical foundation to the community, but also represents a precise forecast of the future form of human-AI interaction. When AI finally learns to "listen" and "interject" like a human, we are one big step closer to the era of intelligent agents that truly understand you and can fight alongside you.
